tasks.label: Start database
args: docker info *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Starting Docker Desktop...'; Start-Process 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'; $n = 0; do { Start-Sleep 3; $n++; docker info *> $null } until ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -or $n -ge 60); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'Docker engine did not start within 3 minutes - check Docker Desktop for an error dialog.'; exit 1 } }; docker compose up -d --wait db
